members.name: Extortionist
hardFails: relies on a rival having more resources (target picked by comparing rivals' resources)
relies on a rival having more resources (the rival with the most resources)

members.name: Landlord
members.why: Flat +2 white; nothing but a flat one-color gain.

members.name: Regular
members.why: +1 blue on follower buys has nothing to do with the shop.

members.name: Volunteer
members.why: Pure cheap filler: worth 1 follower and one red member for the contest; nothing to feel or decide.

members.name: Recruiter
members.why: +1 red per recruit at cost 6 is a small trickle nobody feels.

members.name: Toastmaster
members.why: +1 follower per Silver space: forgettable.

members.name: Critic
members.why: +1 follower when rivals recruit blue; small.

members.name: Timekeeper
members.why: Same 'per member of my color' game-end shape as Snobs and Old Money; nothing purple about it.

members.name: Old Money
members.why: Per white member at game end; repeats Snobs and Timekeeper.

members.name: Patriarch
members.why: Generic game-end scorer that works the same in any wide cult; nobody reacts.

members.name: Dyer
members.why: Same per-color-held shape as Tourist and Caravan, paid in yellow.

members.name: Snobs
members.why: Count-your-color scorer; quiet.

members.name: Picket Line
members.why: Passive +1 purple when rivals use purple; counts 3 for 4 cost is its real value, the ability is forgettable.

members.name: Line Cutters
members.why: First every round for 2 cost and worth 3: must-buy that undoes catch-up turn order.

members.name: Night Watch
members.why: Pays when a rival takes Goes Last, but 'per minion on it' is unclear about what is counted.

members.name: Roadie
members.why: Per green member income; generic shape, no copying.

members.name: Philanthropist
members.why: A small Party Gifts on recruit; repeats the color's spaces.

members.name: Con Men
members.why: Steal 5 on recruit; plain.

members.name: Deprogrammers
members.why: Counts as 4 red members for 3 cost is a contest swing; the follower sting rides on member steals.

members.name: Debt Collectors
members.why: Once-per-game silver collection from everyone; fine timing call.

members.name: Meddler
members.why: Breaks rivals' sets one resource each; small jab, fiddly.

members.name: Window Dressers
members.why: A one-time shop flush; its counts-3 for 4 cost is the real draw.

members.name: Double Agent
members.why: Swap with a rival on recruit; whether it then fires for them is unclear.

members.name: Kidnapper
members.why: Takes a member from the widest rival every round; the victim loses members early with no say.

members.name: Hostesses
members.why: Automatic gift engine each round: +3 followers for 3 silver to rivals; no decision once bought.

members.name: Caterer
members.why: +1 silver on any gift, the whole table's; small trigger.

members.name: Duty Collector
members.why: Pays when rivals recruit your colors; small and needs attention.

members.name: Money Changers
members.why: Pays on anyone's follower buys; constant small trickle.

members.name: Loyalists
members.why: Clean shield against red's swaps; switches off a whole kind of answer for its owner's cult.

members.name: Misers
members.why: Holding white for game end against Cash In is a real choice.

members.name: Mob
members.why: Rewards the red contest leader again each round; 12 cost makes it hard to move and pure rich-get-richer.

members.name: Closer
members.why: Rewards the same last minion the contest already counts; neat but a small bonus.

members.name: High Society
members.why: Pays when rivals take Silver spaces; same shape as Picket Line.

members.name: Trendsetters
members.why: Each recruit cycles the shop; fine, overlaps Window Shopper.

members.name: Bodyguards
members.why: Full theft immunity; clear but switches off magenta against you.

members.name: Agents
members.why: Rivals can't copy you; shuts off green.

members.name: Extra Hand
members.why: An extra minion once, at 9 cost.

members.name: Dabblers
members.why: Two wild members for counts; 'wild' needs a rules lookup.

members.name: Anarchist
members.why: Swap any two members each round; chaotic and powerful, hard to read.

members.name: Sore Loser
members.why: Steal 5 followers from the contest leader if you win none; catch-up.

members.name: Night Owls
members.why: A free extra minion each round from II, placed last, helps the went-last contest; strong but 8 cost and wordy timing.

members.name: Hot Streak
members.why: Once-per-game burst that pays off Crunch Time and Right Away; counting 'turns in a row just before this one' needs care at a table.

members.name: Smooth Talkers
members.why: Silver as any color is a strong rule bend at 11 cost, overlapping Alchemists.

members.name: Body Snatchers
members.why: Every Round Start swap with a rival makes the table watch its members; Loyalists is the visible answer.

members.name: Early Birds
members.why: Cheap immunity to skips; a clean counter to Hold Up and Bouncers.

members.name: Jack-of-All-Trades
members.why: Yellow as wild in sets; simple fix that sharpens the yellow contest.

members.name: Window Shopper
members.why: Cycles the shop and pays colors; steady blue churn.

members.name: Doormen
members.why: Swapping a rival's member for a shop one each round is a strong sting; replacement rule needs a read.

members.name: Accomplice
members.why: Cheap steal 3 on recruit; plain and punchy.

members.name: Grifter
members.why: Steal scales with cult size; rewards the wide leader.

members.name: Shoplifter
members.why: Steal 1 per recruit; small engine piece.

members.name: Recluse
members.why: Pays for staying small, matching white's 'not members' idea; a clear catch-up for small cults.

members.name: Brokers
members.why: +1 on every White follower payout; steady engine piece.

members.name: Impressionist
members.why: Pays on any copy at the table; small.

members.name: Panel
members.why: A Promote or Demote on recruit is a strong red link, but 'promote or demote' needs the space text looked up, and it's not clear whose members it reaches.

members.name: Seamstress
members.why: Once-per-game doubling of full sets is a big moment, but what 'double your full sets' gives you needs explaining.
members.play: no +1.17 vs Harmonist; pass +0.58 vs Harmonist

members.name: Caravan
members.why: +1 of each held color every round fuels sets; strong but 9 cost and pays the already-wide player.

members.name: Hawker
hardFails: turn flow: asks rivals to choose during another player's turn
members.why: Offering a shop member round the table is a real auction moment, but wordy.

members.name: Shopaholics
members.why: Two buys every turn bends the core rule; at 9 cost it runs away for whoever lands it.

members.name: Impersonator
members.why: Borrowing a rival's ability is fun, but which one it has must be remembered.

members.name: Tribute Band
members.why: Do all of a rival's actions once: a huge moment at 14 cost.

members.name: Creditor
members.why: Forced trade of 2 followers for 3 silver each round; aim it at the leader, but 'once per round' on a 4-follower swing is strong.

members.name: Proselytizers
members.why: +1 follower per recruit is the red engine piece; stacks with Gather, Initiation and free recruits.

members.name: Bouncers
members.why: Two rivals skip on recruit: a big, visible moment that feeds Gossip; a fair sting since it's once and shared.

members.name: Gossip
members.why: Rides on Hold Up and Bouncers, anyone's skips; fires maybe once a round, so 6 cost is a stretch.

members.name: Gardeners
members.why: Fills the colors you lack each round, so it pays more to the player with gaps; clean set-building.

members.name: Patroness
members.why: Pays on any bottom-of-pile event, the whole blue toolkit's; connects many cards.

members.name: Fence
members.why: Pays when robbed; a neat answer to theft.

members.name: Raiders
members.why: Steal 4 followers once, paid in white; strong but reads like magenta.

members.name: Spoilsport
members.why: Cancel a contest you can't win; real denial aimed at a leader.

members.name: Godparent
members.why: Give away a member for its cost in followers once; the gift and the timing make it a clean silver idea.

members.name: Guest of Honor
members.why: +4 for gifting a cheap member each Silver space; makes giving members a plan and pairs with Old Maid.

members.name: Tourist
members.why: Followers per color held every round; a strong steady engine.

members.name: Wallflower
members.why: Doubles resources from copies, a green engine; 10 cost.

members.name: Fan Club
members.why: Copy the leader's space on recruit; catch-up.

members.name: Alchemists
members.why: Any resource pays any color when recruiting; strong at 5, counts 3.

members.name: Old Maid
members.why: A hot potato: dump it with Promote, Demote, Godparent or Guest of Honor.

members.name: Foster Parents
members.why: Plays off Promote, Demote, Body Snatchers, Poach, Double Agent and rival gifts; cheap, counts 2, and builds a member-trading engine in few words.
members.play: pass +1.08 vs Greeters; pass +0.87 vs Greeters

members.name: Mentor & Protégés
members.why: Two recruits for one, counts 3 toward the red-member contest; clear and strong, the choice is only when to afford 9.

members.name: Debutantes
members.why: Double your silver once, with rivals topped up; timing it before a silver-contest count or Smooth Talkers spend is a real call.

members.name: Hoarder
members.why: Turn everything white once, then Cash In; a clear setup at 8 cost.

members.name: Song Request
members.why: Copy a rival's space once a round, without placing a minion; strong reading of the board at 7 cost.

members.name: Stunt Double
members.why: Repeat the action you just took on recruit; good after Spree or Housewarming.

members.name: Doppelganger
members.why: Becomes a copy of your best member; unclear whether it copies counts-as and worth.

members.name: Encore
members.why: Doubles one On Recruit; a timing call that grows with what you buy next.
members.play: bot bug -0.18 vs Chronicler; no -0.28 vs Chronicler

members.name: Party Crasher
members.why: Place on a taken space once; bends the blocking rule.

members.name: Drifters
members.why: Choose its color: plays off Big Tent, Mob, the red contest and every per-color count; a clever cheap connector.

members.name: Second-Story Man
members.why: Steal 2 before contests: swings a contest and can be aimed at a leader.

members.name: Courier
members.why: Consecutive turns paying one of each color links purple timing to yellow sets; builds with Right Away and Crunch Time.

members.name: Big Tent
members.why: Up to +2 per color with one member sharpens yellow's breadth into a clear end-game plan.

members.name: Desperado
members.why: Makes every steal bigger while you trail; real catch-up.

members.name: Heiresses
members.why: White per member, then Cash In: a strong combo with a real once-per-game timing call.

members.name: Cashier
members.why: A portable Cash In for 3 that plays off Heiresses and Hoarder; repeats its round III space.

members.name: Martyrs
members.why: Pays its cost when it leaves; combos with Farewell, Promote, Godparent, Poach.

spaces.name: Gather
spaces.why: Same three-round gain-plus-recruit-bonus template as Stash and Allowance; long text for a plain gain, nobody else at the table notices.

spaces.name: Stash
spaces.why: Identical to Gather and Allowance; no magenta angle.

spaces.name: Allowance
spaces.why: Identical to Gather and Stash; no white angle.

spaces.name: Build Up
spaces.why: The plain fuel anchor for green.

spaces.name: Savings
spaces.why: Blue fuel plus a shop-cycling rider; fine.

spaces.name: Shake Down
hardFails: turn flow: asks rivals to choose during another player's turn
spaces.why: The victim chooses their own punishment, a member or its cost; it feels bad, and the rival chooses on your turn.

spaces.name: Sweet Talk
spaces.why: Silver plus conversion, already what Polish does; quiet.

spaces.name: Exchange
spaces.why: Resources to followers at 2 each; close to the follower buy, already doable another way.

spaces.name: Potluck
hardFails: turn flow: asks rivals to choose during another player's turn
spaces.why: Rivals pay one then gain two; everyone touches it but the trade is muddy.

spaces.name: Estate Sale
spaces.why: Farewell paid in white; repeats its sibling.

spaces.name: Harvest
spaces.why: The plain fuel space with color choice; anchors sets.

spaces.name: Demote
spaces.why: Mirror of Promote; giving away the pricier member is rarely right, so it mostly repeats its sibling with a weaker pull.

spaces.name: Walk-In
spaces.why: Blind recruit from the pile with a gift to every rival; you don't know what you pay for until it flips.

spaces.name: Polish
spaces.why: Clean silver-to-colors converter; useful fuel, little table reaction.

spaces.name: Peek
spaces.why: Setting up the pile is a smart blue move, though the order must be remembered.

spaces.name: Bury
spaces.why: Hate-drafting a shop member for half its cost; clear interaction.

spaces.name: Leaders' Tax
spaces.why: Reads where rivals sit to pick a color; interactive but takes a count.

spaces.name: Makeover
spaces.why: Round III rearrange fixes sets and contests; quiet but useful.

spaces.name: Toast
spaces.why: Big silver with gifts to everyone; feeds rivals' silver contest, clear but blunt.

spaces.name: New Blood
spaces.why: Rewards recruiting a new color, good yellow tie, wordy round table.

spaces.name: Splurge
spaces.why: Followers for paying big on a recruit; 'every 1 in round II' leaves round III unclear, and it fits white loosely.

spaces.name: Right Away
spaces.why: Two turns in a row in one line; feeds Courier and Hot Streak, small gain on its own.

spaces.name: Melting Pot
spaces.why: Scales with your color spread; simple yellow payoff.

spaces.name: Lie Low
spaces.why: Small steal plus a round of safety; clean defensive pick.

spaces.name: Reprise
spaces.why: Copy your own earlier action; clean but self-contained.

spaces.name: Tryout
spaces.why: Borrowing a shop member's On Recruit without buying it is a clean twist on the shop and pays off whatever is face up.

spaces.name: Out of Style
spaces.why: Clears a color from the shop; denies rivals' targets in one line.

spaces.name: Last Call
spaces.why: Pays for holding minions back and grabs the last spot; strong but wordy.

spaces.name: Overtime
spaces.why: An extra minion in round III is a clear burst; generic rather than purple's turn-order idea.

spaces.name: Promote
spaces.why: Trading up into a rival's better member is a real table moment and feeds Foster Parents and Deprogrammers; give/recruit wording needs a read.

spaces.name: Hold Up
spaces.why: Skipping whoever is next, even yourself, is a short rule that bends the snake; the self-skip makes timing a real choice.

spaces.name: Help Yourself
spaces.why: Scaling aimed theft; the core magenta check on hoards.

spaces.name: Initiation
spaces.why: A free recruit up to 8 in round III is a plain, big burst any trailing player can grab.

spaces.name: Housewarming
spaces.why: Free new-color recruit up to 5 pushes variety cleanly.

spaces.name: Recruit Twice
spaces.why: An extra buy is the most valuable thing late; plain and strong.

spaces.name: Sample
spaces.why: Borrow a rival member's On Recruit; pick the best one on the table.

spaces.name: Cover
spaces.why: Copy an empty action; dodges blocking cleanly.

spaces.name: Greatest Hits
spaces.why: Every On Recruit again in round III; pays off a built cult.

spaces.name: Heist
spaces.why: Steal 3 followers: plain and aimable at the leader.

spaces.name: Poach
spaces.why: Round III outright member take; big and clear.

spaces.name: Sleep In
spaces.why: Big purple plus the Goes Last token ties straight into the went-last contest; a clear hold-or-take call.

spaces.name: Crunch Time
spaces.why: Two turns right away in few words reshapes the snake; great burst for whoever needs it.

spaces.name: Party Gifts
spaces.why: Spend the bank's silver on rivals for 6 followers; aiming the gift at who's racing the silver contest is a real choice.

spaces.name: Spree
spaces.why: Three recruits in round III is a burst any trailer can grab.

spaces.name: Cash In
spaces.why: The payoff of white's hoard in one line; Heiresses, Hoarder and Estate Sale all point here.

spaces.name: Largesse
spaces.why: Round III giveaway for up to 10 followers that also feeds rivals' silver contest; a burst a trailing player can use.

spaces.name: Farewell
spaces.why: Cast out a member for its cost in followers is White's clearest idea; plays off Martyrs, the blue member contest and the shop.

spaces.name: Echo
spaces.why: Copy the previous action: tiny text, deep because of whatever just happened.
